```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 05_z_scores_calculating_z
title: >
  Calculating z-scores
questions:
  - id: hard_math_time_z
    type: numeric
    prompt: >
      Another person completes the hard test in 115 seconds. Using the sample mean
      of 100 seconds and standard deviation of 15 seconds, what is the $z$-score?
    answer: 1
    tolerance: 0.01
    explanation: >
      $z = (115 - 100) / 15 = 1$. This time is one standard deviation above the
      mean, so it is slower than average.
```
